title: Senate offices (the cursus honorum)
description: The magistracies the Senate fills each summer from the men of the Roman houses. Ranks order the ladder (highest fills first, and a man never stands for a rank below the highest he has held); seats are how many hold the office at once; requires_prior_rank is the cursus honorum (0 = open to any man of age), waived only when no candidate on the ladder remains; a for_life office keeps its holder until death and he stands for nothing else. Effects reach a holder through CharacterRules.effect_total like traits and retinue.

eponymous.description: The magistracy the year is named for; its elections are proclaimed to every court.

for_life.description: Held until death and never refilled while the holder lives; its holder stands for nothing else.
